title: Statewide - Building Envelope Consultant Services
short_description: Statewide building envelope consulting for renovations, repairs, and construction at behavioral health facilities.
project_location: Columbia, South Carolina, USA; statewide facilities in South Carolina
project_scope: Provision of building envelope consulting services for construction, renovation, and repair projects at facilities operated and maintained by the South Carolina Department of Behavioral Health & Developmental Disabilities. Scope includes feasibility studies, cost estimating, design documentation through construction documents and specifications, bidding support, and construction administration. Up to five contracts may be awarded under a 24-month non-renewable term.
services: Building envelope consulting, feasibility studies, cost estimating, structural engineering, architecture services, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, design documentation, construction documents and specifications, bidding, and construction administration.
relevance_explanation:
- General building envelope consulting framework, not a defined structurally ambitious project.
- Focus is on renovations, repairs, and facility support services rather than standout bridges, roofs, or special structures.
- Includes structural engineering, but mainly as part of broad consulting services.
- Up to five contracts may be awarded statewide, indicating a framework-style procurement with limited technical specificity.
- Does not match sbp priority sectors such as bridges, stadiums, long-span roofs, or major cultural/university buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice describes an on-call consultant services contract for multiple future projects across facilities, so no realistic single construction cost can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No consultant fee or estimated contract value is stated. The procurement is for up to five on-call contracts over 24 months, but without project volumes, task orders, or fee basis, no reliable estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested include cost estimating, structural engineering, architecture services, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and civil engineering. Specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided notice.
